## Without plants, most life would not exist!
<hr>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:250px; LEFT:525px; WIDTH:550px; HEIGHT:300px" SRC="images/voc2.png">

## Photosynthesis has provided O~2~ for billions of years
<hr>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:250px; WIDTH:600px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/lifeevolve.jpg">

## Photosynthesis has provided O~2~ for billions of years
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 65%;">

* **&uarr; [O~2~]  provided a new metabolic opportunity for biological diversification**

<br/>

* **&uarr; [O~2~] promotes changes in chemical interactions between rocks, sand, clay, air, oceans, etc.**

<br/>

* **Allows plants to be the base of every food chain**
    + starch storage in plants is major human food source

</div>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:250px; LEFT:700px; WIDTH:300px; HEIGHT:300px" SRC="images/bif.jpg">

## Almost every living thing interacts with plants in some way
<hr>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:200px; WIDTH:700px; HEIGHT:500px" SRC="images/symbiosis.jpg">

## Plants conditioned the land for animals
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:260px; LEFT:5px; WIDTH:650px; HEIGHT:250px" SRC="images/planttime.jpg">

<div style="float: right; width: 37%;">

* **400 MYA: oldest know insects**

<br/>

* **397 MYA: tetrapods evolve in shallow water**

<br/>

* **340 MYA: amphibians evolve**

<br/>

* **310 MYA: reptiles evolve**

<br/>

* **Also... many mass extinctions**
</div>

## Plants are responsible for the products *WE* rely on
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 60%;">

* **Vegetable and animal matter via agriculture and pasture lands allows us to live**

<br/>

* **Textiles, lumber and medicine provide us quality of life**

<br/>

* **Spices, perfumes, dyes,  food stabilizers, emulsifiers, Starbucks, etc. allow us to live our best life**

<br/>

* **Just based on this, can you imagine a life without plants??**
    + this semester we will try to live that life, for one day
    
</div>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:675px; WIDTH:300px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/coffee.png">

## Plants may be responsible for the *future* products we rely on
<hr>
<br/>

**Photosynthetic organisms (plants, algae, marine phytoplankton) may be the future of energy and/or solutions to global change**
<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:275px; LEFT:45px; WIDTH:450px; HEIGHT:325px" SRC="images/biofuel.jpg">

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:300px; LEFT:600px; WIDTH:400px; HEIGHT:275px" SRC="images/ethanol.jpg">

## In a time of uncertainty, plants still provide jobs
<hr>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:180px; LEFT:0px; WIDTH:1100px; HEIGHT:500px" SRC="images/jobs2.png">

## Angiosperms are most important for humans
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 60%;">

* **Flowering plants are most diverse and abundant group**
    + ~350,000 species
    + relatively new in terms of evolution
    
<br/>

* **Most plant products utilized by society are angiosperms**
    + nearly all food staples
    
<br/>

* **Irish potato famine nearly destroyed a society that was dependent on a single species of flowering plant**

</div>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:650px; WIDTH:400px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/potato.jpg">

## This semester, we will.....
<hr>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 60%;">

* **Learn to identify plants in the wild**
    + and create plant collections
    + learn the value of plants in the wild

<br/>

* **Understand how plants function**
    + identify how these processes affect humans

<br/>

* **Explore the past, present and future of agriculture**

<br/>

* **Dig into the various ways plants define our culture**

</div>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:160px; LEFT:640px; WIDTH:350px; HEIGHT:500px" SRC="images/spiderplants.jpg">

<hr>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>

<div style="float: right; width: 62%;">

**Are plants considered boring because of how they are shown/portrayed to us in media, storytelling, education, etc.?**

<br/>

**Or is it simply because they don't move?**

<br/>

**How do we ignore...BREAD, BEER, WINE, OXYGEN so easily?**

</div>
